description: One durable record per scripted fault induced against the real scheduled path (plan §10.7): the manifest the induced fault produced and the bus row the sweep filed for it, so 'we ran fault injection' is a reading rather than a sentence in a session transcript.

bus_key.description: The alert bus row this fault produced (alerts/{day}/{incident}.json), or null when the induction's live-sweep half has not produced one yet.
bus_key.title: Bus Key

fault_id.description: One of `crucible.gate.SCRIPTED_FAULTS`, enforced at write time by `crucible.faults.record_fault` rather than here (see class docstring).
fault_id.title: Fault Id

manifest_key.description: The store key of the manifest named by run_id, which `crucible.faults.record_fault` looked up and verified reads status: failed before this record could be written.
manifest_key.title: Manifest Key

recorded_at_utc.description: RFC 3339, UTC, `Z` suffix. When the injection procedure filed this record, distinct from trading_day — a fault is induced against a trading day's scheduled path, but the record is filed at the wall-clock instant of induction.
recorded_at_utc.title: Recorded At Utc

run_id.description: The run_id of the manifest this record excuses. ULID. The clause that reads this record matches on this field alone, never on trading_day.
run_id.title: Run Id

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema. A consumer that cannot read the version refuses the document rather than guessing.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

title: Crucible fault-injection record, v1
